title: Coalesce redundant gh-pages writes that cancel Pages deployment
mission: Reduce the observed burst of redundant/concurrent gh-pages commits that repeatedly cancels GitHub Pages builds and blocks served verification. Trace which existing projection/publish workflows create the churn, add the smallest content-diff/coalescing/idempotency guard that prevents no-op or superseded publication writes, and verify useful durable projections still publish. Do not create a new scheduler/queue/CURRENT, disable Pages, or drop evidence.
definition_of_done: Durable evidence identifies the concrete gh-pages writers involved in the observed cancellation burst and distinguishes useful byte changes from redundant/no-op publication commits.
At least one mechanism-level guard prevents redundant/superseded gh-pages writes on the highest-frequency path without changing source-of-truth ownership.
A bounded regression or workflow fixture proves unchanged projection bytes do not create an extra Pages-triggering commit while changed bytes still publish.
A post-repair Pages/CI observation demonstrates a deployment can reach completion, or an exact external concurrency boundary is recorded without claiming success.
No new scheduler, queue or CURRENT is introduced; no durable evidence is deleted; no promotion/Human Accepted authority is changed.
